name: SQL Dojo
description: Practice the LeetCode SQL 50 inside DBX. Runs a real PostgreSQL 18.6 engine (PGlite 0.5.13) locally — no server, no setup, works offline. 50 questions with per-question hints and result-set based grading.
releaseNotes: 0.3.2: corrected the engine version — the bundled WebAssembly engine is PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.13), not 16; the workbench now shows the version the engine reports. Progress is stored through the host's plugin storage (host.storage) instead of localStorage, which throws in the sandbox's opaque origin, and falls back to session-only progress with a visible label. Added LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (PGlite Apache-2.0, PostgreSQL License, MIT question bank) to the package, bumped engines.dbx to 0.6.19 (first host with host.storage), and added a WebAssembly preflight that explains in Chinese when the host sandbox blocks wasm instead of surfacing a raw CSP error. LeetCode SQL 50 remains local-only: no database connection, no network.

zh-CN.name: SQL 练习场
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 里刷力扣 SQL 50 题。内置真正的 PostgreSQL 18.6 引擎（PGlite 0.5.13），离线可用、无需配置数据库。每题带考察点标签和思路提示，按结果集判题。
